'''Jerry Boxes''' are loot boxes dropped from [[Hidden Jerry|Hidden Jerrie]]s while [[Mayor Jerry]] is active as mayor.

== Obtaining ==
While [[Mayor Jerry]] is in office, there is a chance that a [[Hidden Jerry]] will appear after the player chops logs, breaks crops, mines blocks or kills [[Mobs]]. Killing a [[Hidden Jerry]] drops a Jerry Box corresponding to its rarity. There is a {{Green|6}} minute cooldown after finding a Hidden Jerry before another one will spawn.

{{Gold|Golden Jerry}} spawn chance can be increased with {{stat|tracking}}.

'''Golden Jerry Box''' can also be obtained as a {{Yellow|'''MINOR'''}} reward from [[Raffle of the Century]], or from the {{Item|Gift Bag of the Century}}.

== Drops ==
Right-clicking with a '''Jerry Box''' in hand opens a menu from which the player can open the box. Drops include {{c}}, [[Skill]] XP and unique {{NPCSprite|Jerry}} items.

All Jerry Boxes drop the same Jerry items (with the exception that Golden Jerry Boxes cannot drop a {{Item|Green Jerry Talisman}}), but higher rarity boxes will drop more coins and Skill XP.

== Trivia ==
*The '''Golden Jerry Box''' appears to have a crown.
*Despite [[Mayor]] candidate {{NPCSprite|Derpy}}'s +50% skill experience buff, the boxes still grant the same amount of [[Skill]] XP if they are opened during his mayorship.
*Farming {{Item|Nether Wart}}s used to not spawn Hidden Jerries, presumably because it used to give {{skill|Alchemy|XP}} instead of {{skill|Farming|XP}}.
*'''Jerry Boxes''' are an effective way to turn {{Coins}} into [[Skills | Skill XP]].
** [[File:Green Jerry Box.png|26px]]'''Green Jerry Boxes''' cost {{BZC| 0.00302666666666667 Green Jerry Box}} per [[Skills | Skill XP]], or {{BZC|337995.206333333 Green Jerry Box}} for level {{Green|LX}}.
** [[File:Blue Jerry Box.png|26px]]'''Blue Jerry Boxes''' cost {{BZC| 0.00151333333333333 Blue Jerry Box}} per [[Skills | Skill XP]], or {{BZC| 168997.603166667 Blue Jerry Box}} for level {{Green|LX}}.
** [[File:Purple Jerry Box.png|26px]]'''Purple Jerry Boxes''' cost {{BZC| 0.000386666666666667 Purple Jerry Box}} per [[Skills | Skill XP]], or {{BZC| 43180.0043333333 Purple Jerry Box}} for level {{Green|LX}}.
** [[File:Golden Jerry Box.png|26px]]'''Golden Jerry Boxes''' cost {{BZC| 0.00062 Golden Jerry Box}} per [[Skills | Skill XP]], or {{BZC| 69236.9035 Golden Jerry Box}} for level {{Green|LX}}.
